install.title: 5-Step Quick Installation Guide
install.step1_desc: Install OPC-Agents using any of the methods below. No technical background required.
install.step2_desc: Run the start command, then open the local URL in your browser.
install.step3_desc: Pick an AI backend (3 options, skippable). Ollama and Moka require no API Key, ready out of the box.
install.step3_apikey_explain: An API Key is a credential for AI services, like a username+password. Get one after registering on OpenAI's website. OPC-Agents stores it locally encrypted, never uploads.
install.step3_ollama_help: Ollama is a local AI service, completely free with data never leaving your machine. Download it from ollama.com and pull a model (e.g. llama3.1) first.
install.step4_desc: If you have a Pro license key, activate it here to unlock advanced features.
install.step4_license_required: Please enter a license key first
install.step5_desc: Installation complete! Try these example tasks to experience OPC-Agents right away.
install.step5_example_email: Write a project progress email to my client
install.step5_example_finance: Record a ¥5000 income for this month
install.step5_example_report: Generate a quarterly business analysis report
